name: adops-mcp
description: CSV-first analytics + optimization for Google Ads and Meta Ads. Import CSV exports locally, run cross-platform reports, anomaly detection, budget optimization, A/B analysis, forecasting. Export bulk-edit recommendations as Google Ads Editor / Meta Ads Manager CSVs. No OAuth, no developer tokens. 17 tools, 4 resources, 3 prompts.

ad_demo_seed.description: Seed a realistic cross-platform demo portfolio (8 campaigns across Google + Meta, 30 days of daily metrics, pre-computed anomaly alerts) so every downstream tool returns meaningful output without any credentials.

ad_csv_import.description: Import Google Ads Editor or Meta Ads Manager CSV exports. Parses campaigns and day-segmented metrics, handles US + European number formats, BOM, auto-detects delimiter and currency. After import, every other tool operates on the user's real data.

ads_export_recommendations.description: Export budget_analyze recommendations as Google Ads Editor CSV, Meta Ads Manager CSV, JSON (for n8n/Zapier), or Markdown (for standup docs). Filters: min_delta_pct, limit, platform. Users paste the CSV directly into their dashboards for bulk action.

platform_connect.description: Register a platform connection manually (alternative to CSV import) for scripted workflows. Stores platform + account label; actual data still flows through ad_csv_import.

campaign_list.description: List and filter campaigns across all imported platforms. Filters: platform, status, query (free-text on name), objective. Pagination: limit (default 20, max 100) and offset.

campaign_create.description: Add a campaign manually for what-if planning. Useful for modeling budget allocation before you import the real data or before you push changes to Google/Meta.

campaign_update.description: Update local campaign fields (daily_budget, status, bidding_strategy, schedule, targeting). Local-only — does not push to Google/Meta; use ads_export_recommendations to generate a bulk-edit CSV instead.

campaign_pause_resume.description: Batch pause or resume up to 50 campaigns in a single call. Local-only state change; export via ads_export_recommendations to apply in the dashboards.

ads_report.description: Unified cross-platform performance report: CTR, CPC, CPM, ROAS, CPA, conversion rate, spend, impressions, clicks. Group by campaign, platform, or both. Date-range filterable.

budget_analyze.description: Budget allocation analysis across platforms with AI-generated recommendations: increase (high ROAS), decrease (weak ROAS with spend), reallocate (moving budget between campaigns), pause (zero-conversion with significant spend). Uses optimization_goal: maximize_roas / maximize_conversions / minimize_cpa.

budget_reallocate.description: Transfer budget between two campaigns across platforms. Returns before/after budgets and expected impact (projected conversions delta based on historical ROAS).

audience_insights.description: Demographic, geographic, and device breakdowns. Uses the metric rows' reach/frequency (Meta) or attribution data when present. Returns top segments by ROAS and CPA.

creative_specs.description: Platform-specific image, video, and text requirements reference (aspect ratios, max file size, character limits) for Google Ads + Meta Ads placements.

anomaly_detect.description: Statistical anomaly detection across recent metrics. Flags CPC spikes, CTR drops, conversion-rate dives, unusual spend. Configurable sensitivity (low/medium/high) and severity sort. Returns actionable alerts per campaign.

ab_test_analyze.description: Compare two campaigns (the A and B variants) with statistical significance testing. Returns winner, confidence level, uplift %, and sample-size adequacy flag.

competitor_benchmark.description: Compare your campaign metrics against industry averages across 9 verticals (ecommerce, SaaS, B2B services, healthcare, education, travel, real estate, finance, consumer goods). Returns delta vs benchmark per metric.

forecast_spend.description: Forecast spend, conversions, and ROAS for the next 7, 14, or 30 days based on recent trends. Returns projected ranges with confidence interval.
